title: 電
teacherNotes: Production C complete package request for L192. Latest origin/main production JSON is complete through L190 火. L191 發 is not yet in production JSON, so this package uses provisional learned chars ["發"] and must remain ready-blocked-by-dependency until L191 merges. G03 missingIndexes are represented as Han-only indexes [1,3] in the draft so both blanks are 電 in 沒電了電話不能用.

generationConstraints.allowedBoundary: origin/main production JSON through L190 火 plus provisional 發 plus current target 電
imageRules: Generate square image / 1:1 composition for each sentence.
No written text, numbers, signs, labels, zhuyin, watermarks, license plates, route signs, station names, blackboard writing, speech bubbles, captions, logos, formulas, arrows, or readable marks.
audioRules: Use repo OpenAI audio flow only.
Generate G02 suffix and G05 wrong-option audio as standalone files from exact text.

approvedSentences.imageNotes: 孩子拿著電話或手機打電話給媽媽，畫面可有媽媽在另一邊接電話的溫和情境。電話或手機螢幕不可有文字、數字、圖示或標籤。
電話或手機沒電不能用，孩子看著黑掉的螢幕或放下電話。螢幕不可有低電量圖示、文字、數字或標籤；用畫面表情呈現不能用。
電車停在月台或軌道旁準備出發，乘客安全站好。不可有車號、站名、文字、數字、路線牌或標籤。
老師用簡單模型或圖像教孩子火力能發電，可有安全的模型火、電燈亮起或發電示意，但畫面中不可出現任何文字、數字、箭頭標籤、公式或黑板字。

approvedSentences.text: 火能發電，又能做飯，真有用。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 火能發電又能做飯真有用
approvedSentences.imageNotes: 安全分區畫面：一邊呈現火力帶動電燈或簡單發電情境，另一邊呈現大人用安全爐火做飯，孩子在旁邊理解火很有用。不可有文字、數字、標籤；火源必須安全且有成人陪同。

G01.reason: 「電話」是本課核心生活詞，目標字清楚。

G03.indexNote: Repo sentence games use Han-only indexes. Handoff [1,4] maps to both 電 only if punctuation is counted; app-compatible Han-only indexes are [1,3].
